strings.name: Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani
strings.summary: British-trained Tamim became heir in 2003 and amir in 2013. His reign combines gas-funded infrastructure, sports diplomacy and regional mediation. Qatar hosted the World Cup and revised its consultative institutions amid scrutiny of migrant-worker rights and concentrated power. He continued regional mediation in 2026.
